orig_text:
If any of these checks fail, the client
MUST abort using a disconnect message (SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT) with a
SSH_DISCONNECT_KEY_EXCHANGE_FAILED as the reason.
correct_text:
If any of these checks fail, the server
MUST abort using a disconnect message (SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT) with a
SSH_DISCONNECT_KEY_EXCHANGE_FAILED as the reason.
notes:
The client has no information about the results of the server-side check.

RFC EDITOR: Edited Original/Corrected text to only include sentence that is affected.

orig_text:
The security considerations given in [RFC5656] and [RFC8731] also
   apply to the ECDH part of the P/T Hybrid key exchange schemes defined
   in this document.
correct_text:
The security considerations given in [RFC5656] and [RFC8731] also
   apply to the ECDH part of the PQ/T Hybrid key exchange schemes defined
   in this document.
